# P16 progress — accounting/state-transition slice saved

Completed the approved bounded accounting slice. Saved
`docs/design/proposal/architecture/accounting-contract-v1.md` and
`accounting-fixtures-v1.json` under `docs/design/proposal/architecture/`.

The proposed handoff is `EconomicEvent -> TreatmentAssessment ->
JournalProposal -> StateTransitionReceipt`. Inputs retain event identity,
entity/book context, time/cutoff, opening-state digest, authority, method,
evidence and assumptions. Outputs separate eligibility from arithmetic and
state mutation. Invariants require context compatibility, independent
journal/state reconciliation, atomic journal/state/receipt commit, idempotent
replay and stale-opening-state rejection. Unresolved or invalid treatment
preserves known facts and performs no domain write.

AC01/A01 and AC02/A02 are matched eligible acquisition cases. AC03/A03 is the
missing-valuation-evidence rejection with `TREATMENT_UNRESOLVED`,
`mathematical_status="unresolved"`, `computation_status="not_computed"`,
`commit=false` and no journal/state delta. AC04 exercises replay; AC05 exercises
stale opening state. Fixtures are synthetic and source-scoped.

The architecture record now contains five proposed contract rows and removes
accounting from the unfinished list. Language/IR, persistence, interfaces and
failure semantics remain unfinished; the integrated profile, dependency order,
fourteen decisions and all wider MC01–MC35/G1–G18 obligations remain open.
Product implementation remains disabled.

Checks still required: run a fresh focused standard-library diagnostic over the
fixture schema, source hashes, balanced arithmetic, unresolved/no-write,
replay and stale-state expectations; then run the registered P16 checker with a
fresh report. Expected structural outcome is continued failure because four
contract rows and the profile are unfinished. Next task after checks is bounded
independent substantive review of this accounting slice.
